bio: Why not treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea in the heart of one of London's most buzzing areas at Caffe Concerto - Northumberland Avenue?  Caffe Concerto Northumberland Avenue is an Italian inspired restaurant and prosecco bar, located in the heart of London, just a stone's throw from Trafalgar Square, Elizabeth Tower and the London Eye.  Their Afternoon Tea is a classic interpretation of the British tradition consisting of delicate finger sandwiches with sumptuous fillings, freshly baked raisin and plain scones, alongside a delicious assortment of pastries and cakes. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco.  This Caffe Concerto site is situated just a short walk from Charing Cross and Embankment stations.
